title: Sparkly tractor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff8b0' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#fff8b0' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe14d'>
    <path d='M12 14 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M86 20 l1.5 4 4 1.5 -4 1.5 -1.5 4 -1.5 -4 -4 -1.5 4 -1.5 z'/>
    <path d='M80 74 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M16 70 l1.5 3.5 3.5 1.5 -3.5 1.5 -1.5 3.5 -1.5 -3.5 -3.5 -1.5 3.5 -1.5 z'/>
    <path d='M50 6 l1.5 3.5 3.5 1.5 -3.5 1.5 -1.5 3.5 -1.5 -3.5 -3.5 -1.5 3.5 -1.5 z'/>
  </g>

  <!-- exhaust pipe -->
  <rect x='62' y='30' width='5' height='14' rx='2' fill='#8a8f99'/>
  <rect x='61' y='28' width='7' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#b9bec7'/>

  <!-- cab body -->
  <rect x='42' y='36' width='28' height='22' rx='3' fill='#e8433a'/>
  <rect x='42' y='36' width='28' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ff6a5e'/>
  <!-- window -->
  <rect x='47' y='41' width='18' height='12' rx='2' fill='#61d6ff'/>
  <rect x='47' y='41' width='18' height='4' rx='2' fill='#a8ecff'/>

  <!-- engine hood -->
  <rect x='16' y='46' width='28' height='16' rx='3' fill='#ff5a4d'/>
  <rect x='16' y='46' width='28' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#ff8378'/>

  <!-- seat -->
  <rect x='66' y='38' width='6' height='18' rx='2' fill='#3a3f4b'/>

  <!-- big rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='72' r='15' fill='#3a3f4b'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='72' r='12' fill='#5a6172'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='72' r='5' fill='#ffd23d'/>
  <g stroke='#8a8f99' stroke-width='1.5'>
    <line x1='68' y1='60' x2='68' y2='84'/>
    <line x1='56' y1='72' x2='80' y2='72'/>
    <line x1='59.5' y1='63.5' x2='76.5' y2='80.5'/>
    <line x1='76.5' y1='63.5' x2='59.5' y2='80.5'/>
  </g>

  <!-- small front wheel -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='74' r='10' fill='#3a3f4b'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='74' r='7.5' fill='#5a6172'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='74' r='3.5' fill='#ffd23d'/>

  <!-- axle bar between wheels -->
  <rect x='24' y='62' width='44' height='5' rx='2' fill='#7d8494'/>

</svg>
